name: DEI token burnFrom reversed allowance lookup
summary: The DEI implementation selected on 2023-04-16 wrote the allowance update inside burnFrom() with the owner and spender arguments transposed, so calling burnFrom(victim, 0) granted the caller an unlimited allowance over the victim and let the attacker transferFrom every DEI holder that had ever approved the token.
notes: The fourth and final pre-exploit Upgraded event selected the vulnerable DEIStablecoin implementation; the implementation slot remained unchanged through the exploit.

Halborn and CertiK report about $6.5 million drained across Arbitrum ($5 million), BNB Chain ($1.3 million), and Ethereum ($135,000) through the same DEI defect. Halborn reports roughly 10% was returned; the gross loss is retained and recovery is not netted.
The loss uses reputable cross-chain reports rather than a separately repriced transaction-level asset ledger for all three chains.
